title: Steel Columns and Beams Fabrication Pakistan | Steel Mind
description: Fabrication of steel columns and beams for factories, warehouses and buildings in Pakistan. Cut, drilled and welded to drawing by Steel Mind.
keyword: steel columns and beams fabrication in Pakistan
h1: Steel Columns and Beams Fabrication in Pakistan: The Main Frame of Your Building
quickAnswer: Columns carry loads down to the foundation, and beams carry loads across openings. Steel Mind fabricates both from rolled and built-up sections, cut and welded to drawing and checked before painting.
alt: Fabricated steel columns and beams with primer coat, ready for dispatch.

faq.a: It is an I-shaped member made by welding two flanges to a web plate, so the depth and thickness can change along the member.
Yes. Parts leave the factory with a primer coat or the coating system chosen for the project.

blocks.title: The Role of Columns and Beams

blocks.text: Columns carry loads down to the foundation. Beams carry loads across openings and pass them to the columns. Together they form the frame that holds the whole building.

items.name: Rolled sections
items.text: Standard I-beams, channels and angles cut to length.

items.name: Built-up sections
items.text: Plates welded into I-shaped members of any depth and thickness, giving an efficient shape for each load.

items.name: Box sections
items.text: Hollow members for heavy loads or where appearance matters.

blocks.text: The team checks the plates and sections on arrival, cuts them to the sizes on the drawing, drills or punches bolt holes, fits and welds the parts, and inspects the welds and dimensions. The parts are then cleaned and painted, marked and packed in erection order. See Painting.
A hole in the wrong place or a beam that is 10 mm short can delay a whole site. Steel Mind checks dimensions after cutting so that parts fit the first time.
